message.content:
**Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was the first institution of higher education in the American colonies. Today it is one of the world’s leading universities, known for its rigorous academics, distinguished faculty, and extensive research output.

Key facts:

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City |
| **Founded** | 1754 (as King's College) |
| **Type** | Private, research university |
| **Ivy League Member** | Yes |
| **Campus Size** | ~36 acres (urban) |
| **Student Body** | ~30,000 total (undergraduate, graduate, professional) |
| **Academic Schools** | Columbia College (undergrad), School of Engineering & Applied Science, School of Business, Law School, Graduate School of Arts & Sciences, School of Medicine, School of Social Work, etc. |
| **Notable Programs** | Journalism (Columbia Journalism School), Law, Medicine, Business, Architecture, Computer Science, Environmental Science, etc. |
| **Research Centers** | Columbia Center for Climate Science, Columbia Data Science Institute, Columbia Human Rights Institute, etc. |
| **Alumni** | 5 Nobel laureates, 2 U.S. Presidents (Woodrow Wilson, Barack Obama), 1 U.N. Secretary-General (Kofi Annan), 1 Supreme Court Justice (John Roberts), many other prominent scholars, artists, and leaders. |
| **Rankings** | Consistently ranked among the top 10 universities worldwide (U.S. News, QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education). |
| **Athletics** | Columbia Lions (NCAA Division I, Ivy League). |

Columbia’s urban campus blends historic architecture with modern research facilities, and its location in New York City provides students with unparalleled access to cultural, professional, and networking opportunities.
